label: preparing
what: Likely a coordinated gathering involving a large bread order and possibly the great hall. Freight paid the baker 24 emeralds and supplied wheat toward 200 loaves; the innkeeper reportedly promised thirty emeralds, and the neighbour was reported with the baker. The secretary and builder are arranging an eighteen-o'clock hall lighting inspection, which could provide a reason to bring me there. The precise event and whether the inspection is connected are unconfirmed; rumours of a bridge or port change do not establish its purpose.
